next_step: POC kickoff: integrate Redwood hosted summarizer with Zendesk macros; SSO test
notes:
Summary: Saltmarsh Assistify builds CX tooling for mid-market SaaS customers (Zendesk + Freshdesk centric). Looking to add automated ticket and email summarization + auto-tagging to reduce AHT and accelerate routing. Current plan: 4-week POC using Redwood hosted API, then evaluate Dedicated for predictable peaks.

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2025-01-08: Intro call (Maya/Ravi) — product + ops. strong interest in summarization + auto-tag mapping to Zendesk custom fields.
- 2025-01-20: Deep-dive (SE demo) — Fireflies ff_2025_01_20_17. demo notes attached in Drive.
- 2025-01-28: Security questionnaire submitted (SOC2 + KMS + data residency follow-ups). Legal asked for EU residency proof for some customers.
- 2025-02-03: Tech call with platform engineering re: tool-calling (create internal note, trigger macro) — discussed webhook flows and idempotency.
- 2025-02-06: Pricing deck reviewed (drive link). Agreed on POC scope and success metrics.

Use-case & requirements (shorthand):
- Workloads: email batches (summary + tags) and live agent assist snippets on open tickets. Priority: ticket/email summarization + auto-tagging that feeds Zendesk macros and triggers.
- Latency/throughput: interactive summarization target <= 800ms (90th) for single-ticket chat snippets; bulk email summarization throughput ~1.5k msgs/hour. Need graceful degradation under spikes (Black Friday style bursts ~3-4x baseline).
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market margins; want unit-cost visibility and batching suggestions to lower per-ticket cost.
- Models: prefer open/quantized models (cost-aware), but need Redwood to validate fidelity vs their existing BERT baseline. Want automatic fallback to smaller summarizer when latency SLOs are in danger.
- Routing/fallback: route EU customer data to EU region; fallback model tier for degraded capacity.
- Security: SSO (SAML) mandatory for admin console, KMS for key management, audit logs for all inference requests, 30-day retention window for POC (longer for enterprise).

Integration specifics & success metrics:
- Zendesk macros + triggers: Redwood outputs JSON summary + suggested tags; a webhook/automation applies tags and fires IP ranges. Must map tags to Zendesk ticket fields (priority, product_area, escalation_needed).
- Tool-calling: ability to add internal note and propose canned replies (agent can accept/reject).
- Metrics: reduce average handle time (AHT) by >=25% on POC accounts; auto-tag precision >=90% on top 15 tags; no more than 1 SLA breach per month during POC; 99.9% availability during scheduled test bursts.

Quotes & vocalized concerns:
- "If it can't handle our Black Friday peak, won't pass compliance" — Ops lead.
- CPO: "Need to see mapping fidelity before we move to Dedicated."

POC plan & next steps:
- Week 0: NDA + SAML metadata exchange + legal sign-off.
- Week 1: POC kickoff — set up Redwood hosted API keys, configure Zendesk sandbox, connect webhook for tag writes.
- Week 2: Ingest 5k historical tickets for offline eval; run eval harness (Redwood Optimize recommended quant/ batching).
- Week 3: Live agent assist pilot with 20 agents; monitor latency, tag precision.
- Week 4: Spike testing (3x, 4x), finalize decision on Dedicated capacity or continue hosted with routing controls.

Blockers (details):
- Legal: needs explicit EU data residency option for EU customers; wants confirmation of KMS key separation.
- SRE: wants proof of throughput under 3x bursts — requests a stress run on dedicated-like instance or documented benchmarks.

Attachments / refs:

- Fireflies: ff_2025_01_20_17 (DEMO)
